system.name: MetaSapiens
system.one_liner: a point-based neural rendering system delivering real-time, human-visual-quality rendering on mobile devices via pruning and foveated rendering

components.name: Fov Filter
components.role: filters out points not needed for a tile's target quality level during Projection (FR augmentation)

components.name: Intersect Test
components.role: tests point/tile intersection feeding the Fov Filter's comparator logic

components.name: Projection, Culling & Conversion
components.role: baseline stage computing point projection, culling, and format conversion

components.name: Line Buf.
components.role: line buffer staging data between Projection/Sorting and Sorting/Rasterization

components.name: Duplication Unit
components.role: baseline unit duplicating points across overlapping tiles

components.name: Tile Merge Unit
components.role: merges tiles with few intersections to balance workload across tiles (workload-imbalance augmentation)

components.name: Tile-Point Accumulator
components.role: accumulates per-tile intersection counts inside the Tile Merge Unit

components.name: Tile ID Reassignment
components.role: compares accumulated counts against threshold beta and assigns merged-tile IDs

components.name: Double Buffer
components.role: baseline double buffer staging tiles into the sorting unit

components.name: Hierarchical Sorting Unit
components.role: baseline unit that sorts Gaussian points within tiles

components.name: Volume Rendering Core
components.role: rasterization core that blends Gaussian samples into pixel colors, augmented to support foveated blending

components.name: Gau. Sample
components.role: baseline unit reading a Gaussian sample for rasterization

components.name: Blend
components.role: interpolates colors rendered at two quality levels for a pixel (FR augmentation)

components.name: DRAM
components.role: shared memory accessed by all three pipeline stages

flows.what: filtered points passing the quality-bound test
accumulated color at a quality level

content.key_idea: MetaSapiens augments GSCore's baseline three-stage PBNR pipeline with a Fov Filter and a Blend unit (yellow) to support foveated rendering, and a Tile Merge Unit (blue) to fix workload imbalance across tiles.
content.reading_order: Left to right through the three labeled stages (Projection, Sorting, Rasterization), each connected via line buffers, with a shared DRAM bus running along the bottom.

summary: This figure shows the hardware architecture of MetaSapiens's point-based neural rendering (PBNR) accelerator, built on the three-stage GSCore pipeline (Projection, Sorting, Rasterization) connected through line buffers and a shared DRAM bus. Baseline GSCore components are left uncolored (white): Projection/Culling/Conversion, Duplication Unit, Double Buffer, Hierarchical Sorting Unit, and the Gau. Sample/alpha-Comp./T-Comp./RGB Accum. chain in the Volume Rendering Core. MetaSapiens adds two categories of augmentation, distinguished by color: yellow components (a Fov Filter in Projection and a Blend unit in Rasterization) support foveated rendering by filtering points against a per-tile quality bound and interpolating colors across quality levels; a blue component (the Tile Merge Unit in Sorting, containing a Tile-Point Accumulator and Tile ID Reassignment logic) merges low-intersection tiles to reduce pipeline stalls from workload imbalance. The figure is laid out as a left-to-right hardware pipeline with stage headers and a DRAM bus spanning the bottom.
summary_zh: 该图展示 MetaSapiens 基于 GSCore 三级流水线（投影、排序、光栅化）的硬件架构：黄色部件（Fov Filter、Blend）为支持中心凹渲染新增，蓝色部件（Tile Merge Unit）用于缓解瓦片工作负载不均衡，白色为原有 GSCore 基线组件。
